scope: Cross-check current open-source parser robustness and strict-consumer reports against local DXF read paths and regression coverage, then refine only existing implementation owners.

method.kind: Read-only research over current official project documentation, source-linked issue reports and release notes, plus targeted local source and test inspection
localInspection: dxfReader::readRec skips post-SECTION comments iteratively and charges each physical record against its record budget.
Entity XDATA group values are parsed iteratively; typed item, node, retained-string, and input-token ceilings exist as distinct controls.

DRW_Image::parseCode bounds IMAGE/WIPEOUT group-91 clip counts; WIPEOUT validates the resulting boundary before callback, while duplicate/restarted group-91 sequences need explicit generated disposition coverage.

Existing hardening tests include a small ignored-comment budget case and comment-retention lifecycle checks; existing IMAGE/WIPEOUT controls test boundary counts but not long repeated-record cases in both encodings.
method.evidenceRule: Peer issue claims are mutable, route/build-specific discovery evidence. They neither transfer defects nor define DXF limits. Local source inspection is not a regression result; generated local tests still need to pass before any implementation status change.

evidence.topic: Repeated DXF records can exhaust the parser call stack in a peer implementation
evidence.observed: The open issue reports recursive per-item advancement for comment runs, XDATA application blocks, and IMAGE/WIPEOUT group-91 clip-boundary groups. Its reproduction thresholds are tied to ACadSharp 3.8.0/master v3.8.10 paths and affect the reporter's ASCII/binary routes.
doesNotEstablish: matching recursive paths or a local crash in libdxfrw
normative maximum counts for comments, XDATA applications, or clip-boundary groups
that peer thresholds should be copied into local format validation
evidence.planUse: Under existing PAR-14/PAR-26/7BA/7S, add generated ASCII/binary stress and malformed controls for comments, repeated XDATA applications, and duplicate/restarted group 91. Assert iterative completion or bounded refusal, exact cursor/record progress, no partial callbacks, and following-entity alignment.

evidence.topic: Cross-project support statements require operation- and consumer-specific claims
evidence.observed: LibreDWG records version-specific bounds, allocation, pointer-lifetime, and progress fixes and documents separate fuzz routes. ezdxf describes ASCII/binary DXF and unknown-tag preservation while its drawing add-on documents no ACIS rendering and XY projection for 3D entities.
doesNotEstablish: general 3D geometry or B-rep semantics from raw DXF preservation
that a peer source declaration or self-roundtrip is independent acceptance
evidence.planUse: Keep parser robustness, opaque carrier retention, explicit-geometry projection, ACIS semantics, and native application acceptance in separate evidence lanes; preserve the existing scheduled fuzz/sanitizer cadence.

evidence.topic: DIMSTYLE and TABLE peer leads now have bounded local controls but remain unqualified externally
evidence.observed: The open DIMSTYLE report describes AutoCAD rejection of ACadSharp 3.6.35 output and an AutoCAD DXFOUT comparison; the TABLE report identifies a block-cell value discrepancy. The local plan records an AC1024 DIMSTYLE compatibility candidate and an ambiguous empty TABLE-cell ASCII/binary control.
doesNotEstablish: a normative DIMSTYLE subclass rule across versions
native/strict-consumer acceptance of the local candidate
semantic equivalence of the peer's DWG table value and local DXF control
evidence.planUse: Retain external acceptance pending for DIMSTYLE and fail-closed incomplete TABLE export; do not promote support from local generated controls.
